description: Sends an HMRC Agent Authorisation invitation for one client and one service, over the deployed API. The client's own VRN or NINO comes from the client row, not from this call. Uses the session's HMRC authorisation: call request_hmrc_authorisation with services agent first if this tool says none is held.

arn.description: The practice's HMRC agent reference number; stored for reuse when given, read back when omitted

knownFact.description: The VAT registration date (MTD-VAT) or the client's postcode (MTD-IT)

service.description: The HMRC service to request authorisation for

name: invite_client
title: Invite a client
